title: Separator __ with names containing a single _ - the property-test case from the javadoc
rationale: FlattenedPath javadoc records a caught bug: with separator "__", segments ["_",""] encoded to "___" and decoded as ["","_"]. The fix was to escape the separator FIRST character rather than the complete separator. This fixture reaches that code from real JSON.
catchesBugClass: The multi-character-separator off-by-one: a trailing separator-prefix inside one segment combining with the following separator to match one character early. Nothing else in the corpus reaches it.
cannotCatch: It cannot catch the empty-segment half of the javadoc example, because sanitizeKey rewrites an empty JSON key before it reaches the encoder. It also says nothing about separators longer than two characters.

predicted.detail: Both keys decode to their exact segments. Neither name contains "__" so sanitizeKey collapse is a no-op here, which isolates the escaping from that control.

configDescription: MapFlattener(true, 50, 1000); JsonReconstructor.builder().separator("__") - quickReconstruct hard-codes "_" and would fail for the wrong reason
